Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment network clearance & ops kickoff

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for picking Redwood for Helios Labs' private deployment. Per our conversation, this thread will coordinate the network and ops readiness for the VPC peering + private endpoints + on-prem package plan. High-level scope for this kickoff:

- VPC peering (cross-account, us-west-2) and route table changes
- Private endpoints for API/control plane traffic
- On-prem package prep (install media, offline keys, install runbook)
- Firewall / NAT / egress rules and test windows

Can you confirm who on your side owns BGP/peering and whether Helios has a static NAT egress IP for the staging environment? If you can share an initial CIDR set and the contact for NetOps, we’ll draft a short preflight checklist and a proposed 2-week integration window.

Proposed immediate next steps (we can adjust after your reply):
1) Helios to share NetOps contact + allowed CIDRs by EOD Tuesday 6/4
2) Redwood will share preflight checklist + network diagram v1 by 6/5
3) Joint 30-min technical alignment call week of 6/6 to review specifics and test plan

We’ll attach the checklist and a draft runbook after we have the NetOps contact.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119

Attachments: none (will send preflight pack once we have NetOps contact)

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@helios.ai>

Cc: netops@helios.ai, Grace Rivera <grace.rivera@stackbridge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment network clearance & ops kickoff

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Copying NetOps (netops@helios.ai) — their lead is Aisha Mehta (aisha.mehta@helios.ai). For staging we have a static egress NAT IP 54.214.118.22 that we can include in allowlists; production will use a pooled egress range, but we’ll provide dedicated IPs for cutover.

Initial CIDR blocks for Helios VPCs (us-west-2):
- prod: 10.10.0.0/16
- staging: 10.20.0.0/16
- onprem transit/edge: 172.31.8.0/24

A few notes from NetOps:
- We prefer VPC peering with route table propagation disabled; we will add explicit route table entries once peering is established.
- For private endpoints we need a certificate thumbprint early (we can accept Let’s Encrypt for staging; prod will require our CA-signed cert).
- On-prem package: we’ll need an offline install image and a signed manifest. HSM integration will be via an API key exchanged out-of-band; contact for Security Ops is Grace Rivera (copied).

Available for a tech alignment call next week: Mon 6/6 10–11am PT or Tue 6/7 2–3pm PT.

Samir
VP Infrastructure, Helios Labs
samir.khan@helios.ai | +1 (206) 555-9001

Thanks Samir — and thanks Marissa for driving. I’m Priyom from Implementation (handoff lead). Quick response with Redwood’s initial commitments and ask list so NetOps has a single place to respond.

Redwood deliverables (what we will produce before the alignment call):
- preflight checklist (PDF) covering ports, CIDRs, cert thumbprint steps, NAT rules, and expected routing changes
- network_diagram_v1 (PNG) showing the peering flow, private endpoint placement, and on-prem appliance connectivity
- onboarding MoP (docx) with cutover plan, rollback criteria, and acceptance tests

Helios asks (we need these to finalize the checklist):
- confirm NetOps lead (Aisha OK?) and preferred contact method for handing over HSM key exchange (email vs. signed SFTP drop)
- confirm TLS cert authority for prod (your CA) and whether Redwood should generate CSR or Helios will provide certs
- share any IP allowlist/denylist for vendor traffic beyond the staging NAT IP above

Tentative timeline (assumes quick turn):
- 6/5: Redwood posts preflight bundle to Drive (link below)
- 6/6: Technical alignment call (pick a time Samir recommended)
- 6/10–6/14: Integration window (staging) — limited traffic testing and smoke tests
- 6/21: Target cutover for pilot (if staging acceptance met)

I’ve attached the current preflight checklist and the first network diagram draft to this thread for your review. Please add line comments in the Drive link if anything looks off.

Action items:
- Aisha (Helios NetOps): confirm you can accept Let’s Encrypt for staging and provide any IPs to add to the allowlist by 6/4
- Grace (Security Ops): confirm HSM exchange method and whether Redwood needs our signed DPA stub for the install package
- Marissa: schedule the 30-min alignment call once Samir confirms time

Priyom Das
